homePage.introduction: dedicated frontend developer based in Germany, focused on creating elegant and user-friendly web solutions.

introText: I'm Cristina Stoian, a passionate and driven frontend developer with a strong enthusiasm for creating engaging and user-friendly web experiences. With a background in multiple accredited training programs, online courses and intensive self-study, I am eager to contribute to innovative projects and collaborate with like-minded professionals.
I've had the opportunity to work on a variety of projects, including building responsive websites, developing user interfaces, and implementing interactive features.

In this portfolio, you'll find a collection of projects that showcase my expertise and creativity. Each project represents a journey of problem-solving and exploration, demonstrating my commitment to delivering high-quality, user-centric solutions. I believe in the power of technology to make a positive impact on the world, and I'm excited to share my contributions with you.
Thank you for visiting, and I hope you enjoy exploring my work!

advicePage.adviceDescription: Interactive web app displaying advice dynamically from the Advice Slip API. A dice button allows quick generation of new tips. The modern layout is styled with CSS and Google Fonts for an enjoyable experience.

jokeTellerPage.jokeDescription: Interactive web app that dynamically fetches and reads jokes using JokeAPI and VoiceRSS. Buttons allow users to generate a joke or navigate to an info page.
jokeTellerPage.noJoke: Press the button to hear a joke!

todoPage.todoDescription: React app for task management, allowing users to add, edit, delete, and mark tasks as completed. Uses hooks like useState for state management and modular components for an intuitive interface.
todoPage.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Task Management App

figoRestPage.description: A modern, responsive restaurant website featuring an interactive menu, gallery, testimonials, and news section. Intuitive navigation and an appealing design, optimized for all devices.

joggaPage.pageTitle: Jogga.ro Transition from React.js to Next.js
joggaPage.description: I contributed to migrating Jogga.ro to Next.js, optimizing load times and SEO through server-side rendering, dynamic content loading, and image optimization.
joggaPage.imageAlt: Interactive map from the Jogga.ro project
keyContributions: Fetched and displayed data dynamically via API.
Optimized UI components for better user experience.
Created an interactive map with markers.
joggaPage.outcome: The project improved Jogga.ro’s performance and strengthened my expertise in Next.js and React.
